documents.title: Map annex 1 to the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk (German original, archival reproduction)
documents.publicationCitation: Annex 1 map to the German copy of the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk, held by the Politisches Archiv des Auswärtigen Amts; digitized excerpt reproduced on Wikimedia Commons.
documents.notes: The archival reproduction shows the treaty demarcation line in blue. It locates primary treaty cartography and removes the generic source-discovery state, but does not itself constitute a fully georeferenced production line.

documents.title: Treaty concerning the Trans-Carpathian Ukraine, signed at Moscow on 29 June 1945
documents.publicationCitation: United Nations Treaty Series, vol. 504, No. 607, pp. 299 ff.
documents.notes: Article 1 states that the frontier between Slovakia and Trans-Carpathian Ukraine as it existed on 29 September 1938, with specified changes, becomes the Czechoslovak-USSR frontier as shown on the attached map.

documents.title: Agreement concerning the regime of the Czechoslovak-Soviet State frontier and co-operation and mutual assistance in frontier questions
documents.publicationCitation: United Nations Treaty Series, vol. 971, No. 14064, Article 1.
documents.notes: Article 1 confirms that the frontier is defined by Article 1 of the 1945 treaty and identifies the authoritative demarcation documents: the Descriptive Protocol signed at Uzhgorod on 8 May 1946 and its album of maps, cartographic materials and geodetic studies for the frontier demarcated in November 1945-April 1946.
